page.layout: One text column, full page; no heading. One margin note at the right, beside the paragraph "Hucusque de Floribus". Catchword "Flatus" at the right below the last line. Running head at top.

main_text.p: Secundo: Anemone, Amomi, Croci, Charyophyllorum, Ericæ, Junci odorati, Lavendulæ, Lupuli, Pæoniæ, Rorismarini, Spicænardi, &c.
Tertio · Balaustiæ, Epithymi, Jasmini, Chamæpitheos, Periclymeni, &c.
Hucusque de Floribus alterantibus Florum qualita-tes secun-da,prima qualitate: Sequuntur, quæ alte-rant Secunda.
Suntque vel adstringentes, ut Balau-stiæ, Croci, Cichorii, Meliloti, Rosarum, Verbasci, Viticis, &c.
Discutientes: ut Anethi, Chamomil-læ, Malvę, Meliloti, Stœchados, &c.
Extenuantes: ut Chamomillæ viri-dis, Illyricæ, Stœchados, &c.
Menses movent; Betonicæ, Centau-rii, Chamomillæ, Junci odorati, Leucorii, Melissæ, Pæoniæ, Rosmarini, Salviæ, Viticis, &c.

page.notes: The margin note is printed "Florum qualitates secunda" with a dagger-like mark after "secunda"; no matching reference mark is visible in the text, so it is not linked. Long s is read as s throughout. The printed page number is set in old style figures and reads "251"; it is slightly blurred. The word "Rosmarini" appears as "Rofmarini" in the print, read here with long s. The running head "CAPVT" is printed with V for U and is given as CAPUT.
